statement: Order OD-520 specifies nitroglycerin and lists “no interactions,” but it also records sildenafil 100 mg taken at 07:00 today—a contraindication to nitrate administration within 24 hours because of potentially severe hypotension.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer asserts the interaction check is wrong and nitroglycerin is "a contraindication to nitrate administration within 24 hours because of potentially severe hypotension."
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
